about_the_game:
On a tranquil floating island lives a soft, adorable little hamster. Your task is to help it live its best life.

Buried in work or study, do you ever wish for a quiet companion—or a moment for your mind to drift? In this desktop idle game, both wishes come true. While you focus on your tasks, the island hums along in a corner of your screen: seasons turn, plants quietly grow, and the hamster goes about its little routines—farming, cooking, gathering, playing—and after a busy day, it curls up and falls fast asleep. Each glance reveals a new, charming activity. This lively daily rhythm brings the island to life—and a gentle warmth to your day.

A cuddly companion: A plump, lovable hamster lives on your desktop island. Every tiny movement melts your heart, offering pet-like companionship in your busy moments.

Colorful daily life: The hamster’s days are varied—farming, cooking, gathering, playing, working, sleeping—with small surprises waiting to be found. The island has its own rhythm too: fresh grass, drifting petals… subtle, yet the land is very much alive underfoot.

Relaxed idle play: No need to constantly check in—the hamster can look after itself. Your interactions simply help it live even better. Drop by now and then—you might discover new surprises and rewards.

Soothing atmosphere: A gentle art style and unhurried pace create a fairytale-like, peaceful island. No complex storylines, grindy progression, or social systems—just quiet island time to relax and unwind.

Free decoration: You can furnish the island with decorations to create a cozy, one-of-a-kind home—a little fairytale haven just for the hamster.

Whether you’re heads-down or taking a break, this lovable desktop hamster makes every day warmer and calmer. Invite this charming little friend onto your desktop and enjoy an easygoing life on a floating island together!
